prompt: Write a one-star review of Yellowstone from a driver whose schedule was disrupted by bison.
response: I gave this park one star because that’s the only option. Zero isn’t available. I was driving through, perfectly on schedule, when an absolute unit of a bison decided the middle of the road was his personal napping spot. No warning. No regard for my timetable. Sat there for 45 minutes. Forty. Five. Minutes. Just staring at my car like I owed him money. The rangers did nothing—apparently, “he has the right of way.” It’s a road. For cars. The scenery was fine, I guess, but I was too stressed about my delayed itinerary to enjoy it. If you value punctuality, take the interstate.
